package.name: world_model
package.description:
Shared world-context library: derives what the world contains and where things are, from the Gazebo world SDF, the occupancy map YAML, and the live /object_map poses.
Deliberately contains no ROS node and does not depend on rclpy -- it is a plain Python library consumed by both a Layer 3 node (perception, which needs the object/zone/robot classification) and Layer 1 (which needs the full environment prompt block). Those two consumers are why this is its own package rather than living inside either of them.
